# openalexConvert

Convert an [OpenAlex](https://openalex.org) parquet corpus (produced by
[openalexPro](https://github.com/openalexPro/openalexPro)) into
bibliography formats via [Pandoc](https://pandoc.org): CSL JSON, BibTeX,
BibLaTeX, Markdown, LaTeX, HTML, or PDF, and into
[Zotero](https://www.zotero.org).

## Installation

``` r

install.packages(
  "openalexConvert",
  repos = c("https://openalexpro.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org")
)
```

Pandoc must be installed and on your `PATH` (or installed via
`install.packages("rmarkdown")` which bundles Pandoc on most platforms).

## Quick start

``` r

library(openalexConvert)

# 1. Convert an openalexPro parquet corpus to CSL JSON
corpus_to_csljson(
  corpus = "path/to/parquet",
  output = "path/to/csljson"
)

# 2. Convert CSL JSON directory to BibTeX
csljson_convert_pandoc(
  input  = "path/to/csljson",
  output = "path/to/bibliography.bib",
  to     = "bibtex"
)
```

## Zotero

With the Zotero desktop app (Zotero 10) running, select the target
library or collection in Zotero, then:

``` r

# 3. Import the CSL JSON into Zotero; the OpenAlex ID goes into Extra
csljson_to_zotero("path/to/csljson")
# or both steps in one, into the collection <project> > <corpus>:
corpus_to_zotero("path/to/project")

# 4. After tagging in Zotero: read the tags back, by OpenAlex ID
zotero_tags("path/to/project")  # writes path/to/project/zotero_tags.parquet
```

## Documentation

Full documentation and vignettes:
<https://openalexpro.github.io/openalexConvert/>

## Related packages

- [openalexPro](https://github.com/openalexPro/openalexPro) — API access
  and parquet output
- [openalexSnowball](https://github.com/openalexPro/openalexSnowball) —
  snowball citation search

# Package index

## All functions

- [`corpus_export_via_pandoc()`](https://openalexpro.github.io/openalexConvert/reference/corpus_export_via_pandoc.md)
  : One-shot export via CSL JSON + Pandoc
- [`corpus_to_csljson()`](https://openalexpro.github.io/openalexConvert/reference/corpus_to_csljson.md)
  : Convert a corpus to CSL JSON (chunked)
- [`corpus_to_zotero()`](https://openalexpro.github.io/openalexConvert/reference/corpus_to_zotero.md)
  : One-shot export of a corpus to Zotero
- [`csljson_convert_pandoc()`](https://openalexpro.github.io/openalexConvert/reference/csljson_convert_pandoc.md)
  : Convert CSL JSON (file or directory) via Pandoc
- [`csljson_to_zotero()`](https://openalexpro.github.io/openalexConvert/reference/csljson_to_zotero.md)
  : Import CSL JSON files into Zotero
- [`zotero_tags()`](https://openalexpro.github.io/openalexConvert/reference/zotero_tags.md)
  : Read Zotero tags by OpenAlex ID
